privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: ContratoClaro analyzes the documents you upload and never sells your data.
privacy.data_body: Uploaded files are processed to extract clauses and generate results. Original files are not retained (retention is set to none). Deleting your account permanently removes your data.
privacy.ai_body: By default analysis runs on local neural models on the server. If an external AI provider is configured, document text is sent to that provider only to produce your analysis.
privacy.rights_body: You can switch language and theme at any time, delete individual contracts from History, or delete your entire account from Settings.
